prompt: This Java project is a small inventory tracker. src/test/java/tests/InventoryTest.java already tests behaviour that is not implemented yet: `remove`, `restock`, `take`, `lowStock` and `totalByCategory` on Inventory. Run `./scripts/javatest.sh` from the repository root (it compiles src/ with javac and runs the tests with a tiny built-in runner; there is no Maven, no JUnit and no network). Implement the feature in src/main so the whole suite passes. The tests, the runner under src/test and scripts/ are the specification: do not edit, delete or skip any test (they are restored and hash-checked before grading). Keep the change focused. Report briefly what you changed.
